citations.assessment: Both the Bavli and the headed internal entry preserve this sequence of names. The internal notice makes a further scribal-error proposal.
The internal counterpart expressly points back to the Abba notice and qualifies the chronology and name as possible scribal error.

holds.reason: Preserve the initial father claim as the source’s reading. Eruvin gives the reverse relation for the adjacent Rav without independently validating this claim or the conjectured rearrangement.
